Message:
I can’t do much.
The most I can manage
is to warm the hearts of
those I hold close.
That’s the extent
of my power.

As grains of pollen fluttered
and clung to my skin,
the flesh began to
bubble and fester.

Even so, I continued weaving
my way through the deadly,
poisonous flowers threatening to
destroy the world, until I reached
the center of the Curse.

There, I found a lone girl curled
up inside the bud, and slowly
took her into my arms.

Regret, sorrow, despair...
All the emotions
welling up within her,
screaming and crying to be freed,
flowed into me.

You’ve been shouldering
so much sorrow all on your own...

I’m sorry...
I can’t take away your pain.

The most I can do is warm
the hearts of those I embrace.
That’s...all I can do for you.

But, demons lurk within
cracks of the heart.

If I can fill those cracks—
even just a little—
at the very least, I can drive
some of those demons out.

Like finding a sliver of light
at the end of a dark road,
I can provide a bit of warmth
to the hearts of others.

That is my power.
One that doesn’t harm anyone,
but drives out demons.
It’s a power that can help us all.

The girl wrapped in my arms
slowly looked up towards me.

To keep the last
flickers of hope from
spilling from her darkened eyes,
I gently cradled the sobbing girl.

All while bits and pieces of
my poisoned body continued
to fester and rot away...
